names.note: Name page 9240 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Пахомий (Русин), иеромонах, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Пахомия». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the corpus's `demetrius-rusinov` is a different surname as well as a different forename.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», one year for both men of the entry; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера, прмч. Пахомия (1938).»

attestations.note: The second man of the day's twelfth and last entry. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE DISAGREE ABOUT THE GRADE: the line heads him «прмч.», venerable-martyr, and name page 9240 «сщмч.», hieromartyr — the third such disagreement on this one day. `venerable-martyr` is written from the line, `hieromonk` from the name page's rank, and `hieromartyr` was NOT written. NO `office` IS WRITTEN. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*rusin*` returns only `demetrius-rusinov`. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
